differences.aspect: app entry point and DataFrame index serialization
differences.native: LeetCode calls pivotTable(weather), whose exact body returns the pivoted DataFrame with month as its named index.
differences.app: The identical pivotTable function is retained, while solve calls it and resets the named index so the JSON table result includes month as an ordinary output column.
differences.rationale: The app runner invokes solve and serializes DataFrame columns rather than pandas indexes. reset_index changes only the transport representation; the pivot operation, row labels, city columns, values, ordering, and complexity remain anchored to the exact native function.
